sentences.l2: 在商业管理领域，决策方式长期存在两种取向的博弈。
sentences.l1: In the field of business management, there has long been a contest between two orientations in decision-making.

sentences.l2: 一种是“拍脑袋”式决策，管理者凭借个人直觉或零散印象迅速拍板，看似果断高效，实则风险潜伏其中。
sentences.l1: One is "off-the-cuff" decision-making, in which managers rely on personal intuition or scattered impressions to make a quick call, which seems decisive and efficient, but in fact risks lurk within it.

sentences.l2: 与之相近的是经验主义，即过度依赖过往成功的惯例，忽视环境已然发生的变化。
sentences.l1: Similar to it is empiricism, that is, over-reliance on past successful conventions while ignoring changes that have already taken place in the environment.

sentences.l2: 某连锁餐饮企业的区域经理曾坚信“周末必定客流最旺”，于是将大部分人手集中在周末，结果工作日的外卖订单激增时，门店却人手不足，顾客怨声载道。
sentences.l1: A regional manager of a restaurant chain once firmly believed that "weekends must have the busiest foot traffic", so he concentrated most of the staff on weekends; as a result, when takeaway orders surged on weekdays, the stores were short-staffed, and customers complained bitterly.

sentences.l2: 相比之下，数据驱动的决策强调以可验证的事实为出发点。
sentences.l1: By comparison, data-driven decision-making emphasizes taking verifiable facts as its starting point.

sentences.l2: 企业通过收集销售记录、顾客反馈与时段客流，经过分析后再调整排班。
sentences.l1: By collecting sales records, customer feedback and foot traffic by time period, the company adjusts staff scheduling after analysis.

sentences.l2: 这种做法与医学领域的循证理念一脉相承：结论必须经得起证据检验，而非取决于资历深浅。
sentences.l1: This approach is in the same vein as the concept of evidence-based practice in the medical field: conclusions must withstand testing by evidence, rather than depend on seniority.

sentences.l2: 当然，数据并非万能，它同样需要经验去提出问题。
sentences.l1: Of course, data is not omnipotent; it likewise needs experience to raise questions.

sentences.l2: 真正成熟的管理者，往往能在二者之间取得平衡，让直觉接受数据的检验。
sentences.l1: Truly mature managers can often strike a balance between the two, letting intuition be tested by data.
